script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mars is squaring your ruling Venus today in the 5th House, igniting passionate love conflict. If you're single, Venus‑Mars clash draws magnetic charm and new connections today; if taken, watch for trust sparks. Stay mindful of verbal sparks today, and a brief pause can defuse rising tension. The Jupiter sextile brings a promotion bonus today, but curb impulsive spending that could erase the gain. Saturn’s trine to Mercury today in the 2nd House encourages a modest savings plan to safeguard the windfall. Avoid rash financial commitments today, or the Mars‑driven urge may jeopardize your stability. Follow for tomorrow's reading to stay ahead of the cosmic shifts.
